newsitem.title: USA: Delaware Gov signs bill creating Secy of Education.
newsitem.headline: Delaware Gov signs bill creating Secy of Education.

text.p: Delaware Gov. Thomas Carper on Tuesday signed legislation replacing the current Superintendent of Public Instruction with a Secretary of Education.
Carper said he would name a nominee, who must be confirmed by the state Senate, in mid-March.

"This change in structure at the highest level of Delaware's education system will ensure that a Secretary of Education can be more accountable for progress in our schools," Carper said in a statement.

The secretary, who serves at the pleasure of the governor, would be responsible for managing education regulations and finances under the terms of a companion bill not yet acted upon by the Legislature.
